The unbounded `hits` map, hardcoded `retryAfterSec: 60`, and per-process state are also real issues. The per-IP-only weakness and the question of counting successful logins are legitimate design concerns. The X-Forwarded-For point is conditional on code not shown, but it is phrased appropriately. The ranking is sensible, with the concrete bug first and architectural concerns after. Each item includes a fix or direction. It avoids flagging correct code, and I found no false claims.
